# Zwergischer Erzsucher

A demi-human occupation with a range roll and a long compound name: the
people under its caption first, then the weapon and the goods. The name
wraps to two lines beside the badge. Invented for this deck.

```card-forge
card:
  system: dcc
  card-type: occupation
data:
  name: Zwergischer Erzsucher
  original-name: Dwarven ore-finder
  roll: "44–45"
  roll-min: 44
  roll-max: 45
  race: Zwerg
  trained-weapon: Spitzhacke (als Streitaxt)
  trade-goods: Beutel mit Erzproben
  reference: Regelwerk S. 26
```
